name: DeepSeek (Web & App)
limits: Free access to DeepSeek-V3 and DeepSeek-R1 reasoning models with standard hourly rate limits.
description: Leading open-weights reasoning model with mathematical and code chain-of-thought capabilities matching top frontier models.

name: DuckDuckGo AI Chat
limits: Fair-use daily query quota; chats are completely anonymous and never used for model training.
description: Private, zero-account chat interface accessing Claude 3 Haiku, Llama 3.3, and Mixtral without tracking.

name: ChatGPT Free
limits: GPT-4o mini unlimited; capped access to GPT-4o with temporary rollbacks to 4o-mini during peak hours.
description: Fast conversational assistant, web browsing, and custom GPT explorer.

name: Codeium / Windsurf Free
limits: Unlimited single-line and multi-line code completions for individual programmers.
hardware: Cloud plugin for VS Code, JetBrains, Vim, Chrome
description: Fast, high-quality code autocompletion supporting 70+ programming languages without subscription fees.

name: Continue.dev
limits: Unlimited (Bring your own local models via Ollama or LM Studio).
description: Open-source autopilot extension for VS Code and JetBrains connecting directly to local Qwen 2.5 Coder or DeepSeek.

name: Stable Diffusion WebUI / ComfyUI
limits: Unlimited generation; speed depends strictly on local GPU.
hardware: 6GB+ VRAM GPU recommended (Nvidia CUDA or Apple Silicon Mac)
description: Node-based generative image canvas with fine-grained control over checkpoints, LoRAs, ControlNet, and upscaling.

name: Recraft AI
limits: 50 daily free credits for vector SVG, 3D icon, and raster art generation.
description: Specialized generative tool creating clean vector SVGs, logo icons, and design illustrations ready for Figma.

name: OpenAI Whisper (Local Speech-to-Text)
limits: Unlimited audio transcription and subtitle generation.
hardware: Runs on CPU or GPU; lightweight Whisper-base models run on laptops
description: State-of-the-art multilingual speech recognition that transcribes recordings, interviews, and videos into SRT/VTT with timestamps.

name: Kokoro TTS
hardware: Extremely lightweight (82M parameters; runs on standard CPUs)
description: High-quality, natural-sounding open-weight text-to-speech model with expressive cadence and rapid generation speed.

name: Ollama
description: CLI and background daemon for downloading and running Llama 3.3, DeepSeek-R1, Qwen 2.5, and Gemma 2 on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

name: LM Studio
commercial_use: Personal use free (business license requires contacting team)
hardware: Dedicated GPU or Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) recommended
description: Beautiful desktop GUI for browsing HuggingFace GGUF models, chatting offline, and serving a local OpenAI-compatible API endpoint.
